```{python}
#| include: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl
import plotnine_polars as p9
from plotnine_polars import aes
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pyfixest as pf
from maketables import ETable
from era_pl import load_data, ols_dropcollinear
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
pl.Config.set_tbl_cols(200)
pl.Config.set_tbl_width_chars(120)
pl.Config.set_tbl_hide_dataframe_shape(True)
pl.Config.set_tbl_hide_column_data_types(True)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)
N   = 1000
x1 = rng.standard_normal(N)
x2 = rng.standard_normal(N)
e  = rng.normal(0, 0.2, N)
y  = 1.0 * x1 + 2.0 * x2 + e
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(N), x1, x2])
X[:6]
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
b = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X) @ (X.T @ y)
print(b)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
model = sm.OLS(y, X)
fm = model.fit()
print(fm.params)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def ols_fit(data, formula, **fit_kwargs):
    return smf.ols(formula, data=data.to_pandas(),
                   missing="drop").fit(**fit_kwargs)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
df = pl.DataFrame({"y": y, "x1": x1, "x2": x2})
fm = ols_fit(df, "y ~ x1 + x2")
print(fm.params)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm2 = ols_fit(df, "y ~ x1 * x2")
print(fm2.params)
```

pl.Config.set_tbl_rows(6)

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
test_scores = load_data("test_scores")
test_scores
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
camp_attendance = load_data("camp_attendance")
camp_attendance
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
camp_attendance.select("camp").mean()
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
camp_scores = (
    test_scores
    .join(camp_attendance, on="id")
    .rename({"camp": "treat"})
    .with_columns((pl.col("grade") >= 7).alias("post"))
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
(
    camp_scores
    .group_by(["grade", "treat"])
    .agg(pl.col("score").mean().alias("score_mean"))
    .sort(["grade", "treat"])
    .ggplot(aes(x="grade", y="score_mean",
            color="treat", linetype="treat"))
    .geom_line()
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
test_summ = (
    camp_scores
    .filter(pl.col("grade").is_in([6, 7]))
    .group_by("post", "treat")
    .agg(pl.col("score").mean())
    .pivot(on="post", values="score")
    .rename({"true": "post", "false": "pre"})
    .with_columns(change=pl.col("post") - pl.col("pre"))
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
test_summ.with_columns(pl.col(pl.Float64).round(3))
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
treat_change = test_summ.filter(pl.col("treat")).select("change").item()
control_change = test_summ.filter(~pl.col("treat")).select("change").item()
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_dd = (
    camp_scores
    .filter(pl.col("grade").is_in([6, 7]))
    .pipe(ols_fit, formula="score ~ treat * post")
)
fm_dd.params
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_dd_all = (
    camp_scores
    .pipe(ols_fit, formula="score ~ treat * post")
)
fm_dd_all.params
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_dd_trend = (
    camp_scores
    .pipe(ols_fit, formula="score ~ treat * post + grade")
)
print(fm_dd_trend.params)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_grade = (
    camp_scores
    .pipe(ols_fit, formula="score ~ C(grade)")
)
fm_grade.params
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
mean_by_grade = (
    camp_scores
    .group_by("grade")
    .agg(pl.col("score").mean().round(3).alias("score"))
    .sort("grade")
)
mean_by_grade
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
fm_id = (
    ols_dropcollinear(
        data=camp_scores,
        formula="score ~ treat * post + C(grade) + C(id)")
)
X = fm_id.model.exog
X.shape
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
camp_scores_demean = (
    camp_scores
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("score") - pl.col("score").mean().over("id")
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("score") - pl.col("score").mean().over("grade")
    )
)

fm_demean = (
    camp_scores_demean
    .pipe(ols_fit, "score ~ treat * post")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_dd_fe = (
    camp_scores
    .pipe(ols_dropcollinear,
          formula="score ~ treat * post + C(grade)")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fefm = pf.feols(
    fml="score ~ I(post * treat) | grade + id",
    data=camp_scores
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
comp = (
    load_data("comp")
    .with_columns(pl.col("big_n").cast(pl.Int64))
)

base = (
    "big_n + size + lev + mtb + "
    "C(fyear) * (inv_at + I(d_sale - d_ar) + ppe)"
)

fm = ols_fit(comp, f"ta ~ {base} + cfo")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_aux_ta  = ols_fit(comp, f"ta  ~ {base}")
fm_aux_cfo = ols_fit(comp, f"cfo ~ {base}")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
aux_data = pl.from_pandas(
    pd.DataFrame({
        "ta":  fm_aux_ta.resid,
        "cfo": fm_aux_cfo.resid,
    }).dropna()
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm_aux = ols_fit(aux_data, "ta ~ cfo")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
(
    aux_data
    .drop_nulls(subset=["cfo", "ta"])
    .ggplot(aes(x="cfo", y="ta"))
    .geom_point(size=1, color="tab:green")
    .geom_smooth(method="lm", se=False, linetype="--", color="tab:red")
    .geom_smooth(method="lowess", se=False, color="tab:blue")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
(
    aux_data
    .drop_nulls(subset=["cfo", "ta"])
    .filter(pl.col("ta").abs() < 1)
    .ggplot(aes(x="cfo", y="ta"))
    .geom_point(size=1, color="tab:green")
    .geom_smooth(method="lm", se=False, linetype="--", color="tab:red")
    .geom_smooth(method="lowess", se=False, color="tab:blue")
)
```
